author: Chris Cooley
name: Null Invaders
description: Fly an interceptor through a real webpage. Turn letters into binary, break the button factories, and clear the aliens they release.
versionNote: Four waves. One page. Increasing firepower.
controls: Mouse / WASD / arrows — fly and aim
P — pause · G — next factory · Esc — Recall
Scoreboard: sound · pause / resume · minimize · Recall

chapters.title: Every heading is cover. Every button is a factory.
chapters.body: Bullets travel through viewport space and collide with cached text geometry. A hit writes a literal 0 or 1 into the existing DOM Text node. That letter can be consumed once, and inherits its real page font and color. Button health drains through a liquid fill. A destroyed factory stops spawning for the rest of that wave.

chapters.title: Get stronger during the fight.
chapters.body: Pulse starts with one shot. Twin unlocks at 8 XP, Trident at 24, and four-shot Overdrive at 50. Letters give 1 XP, aliens 4, factory hits 2, and a destroyed factory another 8. Fire cadence accelerates from 160 ms to 95 ms. Weapon pods appear on the interceptor as it upgrades.

chapters.title: A tiny cast, built from pixels.
chapters.body: The cyan interceptor keeps its split nose, stepped wings, lime core, and twin engines through Pulse, Twin, Trident, and Overdrive. Movement drives small thrust and banking frames. Finite pixel variants are baked once and reused with smoothing disabled; collision and firing geometry stay stable.

chapters.title: Fast shots still hit thin letters.
chapters.body: A swept segment test checks the path from the previous bullet position to the next. The nearest intersecting glyph, alien or factory wins, so a fast projectile cannot simply jump across a narrow letter between frames. Alien and bullet objects are recycled through bounded pools.

extra: Three shields. Four waves. Factories reactivate between waves. Chained kills build a multiplier up to ×5; losing a shield resets the combo, but keeps your weapon.

characters.name: Interceptor
characters.rules: Steer with the mouse or arrow keys. Hold Fire or Space. Shooting page text leaves real binary behind; weapon upgrades unlock at 8, 24 and 50 XP.

characters.name: Drone
characters.rules: The slowest alien shape. Spawns from live button gates and chases your ship with a sideways sway. One hit early; two from wave 3.

characters.name: Crab
characters.rules: Uses the same pursuit rules as the drone, with a higher movement speed. Contact costs a shield. Destroy its gate to stop that spawn source.

characters.name: Squid
characters.rules: The fastest of the three alien shapes. Health rises with the wave, just like the other aliens; keep moving while firing.
